MaisonPage.title: A house built on precision
MaisonPage.intro: IOMA was founded in Paris on a conviction that still guides every formula today: skincare should be prescribed, not guessed at.
MaisonPage.philosophyBody: Long before a single product reaches you, a diagnosis does. Every IOMA routine begins by reading what your skin actually needs — not what a generic range assumes it needs.
MaisonPage.pillar1Body: No two skins are alike. Our technology and our formulas are built to reflect that, not to average it away.
MaisonPage.pillar2Body: Formulated and developed in France, with the rigor of a house that treats skincare as a precise discipline.
MaisonPage.pillar3Body: Every range is built around a clear purpose — hydration, renewal, calm — rather than a long list of unrelated promises.
MaisonPage.ctaBody: The best way to understand La Maison IOMA is through your own diagnosis.

TechnologyPage.title: Skin, read precisely
TechnologyPage.intro: Before we recommend anything, we measure. IOMA's diagnosis technology is built to understand your skin's real, current state — not a generic profile based on age or skin type alone.
TechnologyPage.step1Body: A short, precise questionnaire — or an in-person session with a partner — captures your skin's actual needs across hydration, firmness, radiance, and more.
TechnologyPage.step2Body: Your answers determine which range and routine steps are right for you, following rules set by our formulation team, not a generic quiz.
TechnologyPage.step3Body: You receive a clear morning and evening routine — the products you need, in the order they work best, nothing superfluous.
TechnologyPage.aiBody: For an even more precise read, our AI-assisted skin analysis studies a photo of your skin for indicators like texture, tone, and fine lines. Results are always clearly labeled and never presented as a medical diagnosis.

TreatmentsPage.title: In-cabin treatments, led by diagnosis.
TreatmentsPage.intro: Every protocol below starts from the same principle as the at-home routine: a real reading of your skin, not a generic menu.

ProfessionalsPage.title: Bring diagnosis-led skincare to your business.
ProfessionalsPage.intro: IOMA's professional program is built for spas, aesthetic clinics, beauty institutes, and hotels that want to offer the same precision-first approach we bring to individual clients.
ProfessionalsPage.benefit1Body: Professional-strength formulas, priced and packaged for in-cabin use, not sold at retail.
ProfessionalsPage.benefit2Body: Step-by-step treatment protocols and hands-on training for your team, so every session follows the same diagnosis-first standard.
ProfessionalsPage.benefit3Body: A dedicated professional ordering portal with your own pricing, plus ongoing support from our team.
ProfessionalsPage.process3: Once approved, you get access to the professional portal

FaqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqPage.q1Body: You answer a short, precise questionnaire — or visit a partner for an in-person session. Your answers determine the range and routine that fit your skin.
FaqPage.q2Title: Is the AI skin analysis a medical diagnosis?
FaqPage.q2Body: No. It's a simulated, informational analysis intended to guide your routine — never a substitute for medical advice. Results are always clearly labeled.
FaqPage.q3Title: Do you deliver across the UAE?
FaqPage.q3Body: Delivery details and coverage are confirmed at checkout once our shop is live — see Shipping Policy for the latest information.
FaqPage.q4Title: How do I become an IOMA professional partner?
FaqPage.q4Body: Visit the Professionals page and submit an application. Our team reviews every request and follows up with next steps.
FaqPage.q5Title: Can I delete my diagnosis or AI analysis data?
FaqPage.q5Body: Yes — you can delete your saved diagnoses and AI analysis images and results at any time from your account.
FaqPage.contactCta: Still have a question? Contact us
